description: Source code implementing the DecodedAudio class and related functions for handling decoded audio data, including format conversion, seeking adjustments, and comparisons within the starboard::shared::starboard::player namespace.

classes.name: DecodedAudio
classes.description: Class representing decoded audio data with methods for format conversion, seeking, cloning, and comparison.

methods.name: ConvertSample
methods.description: Converts between int16_t and float sample formats.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::frames
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::IsFormat
methods.description: Checks if the audio format matches specified sample and storage types.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::ShrinkTo
methods.description: Reduces the size of the audio buffer.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::AdjustForSeekTime
methods.description: Adjusts the audio data for a seek operation based on sample rate and target time.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::AdjustForDiscardedDurations
methods.description: Discards specified durations from the front and back of the audio buffer.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::SwitchFormatTo
methods.description: Converts the audio data to a different format and storage type.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the DecodedAudio object.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::SwitchSampleTypeTo
methods.description: Converts the sample type of the audio data.

methods.name: DecodedAudio::SwitchStorageTypeTo
methods.description: Converts the storage type of the audio data.
